dynamic_line: Well, if you're gatherin' cigs, maybe bring some back for me, yeah?  Tell ya' what I bet they got crates full of them in shipping containahs, if you're willin' to dig around.  My cousin's fathah - not really my uncle, but long story - ran one close by.  His name's Mike.  If ya' see'im, ask how his mothah is.  But seriously, if ya' go, go careful, yeah? responses.text: Thanks a lot.  Maybe I'll check it out.
